subject: FOCUS DECISION: frozen visual interaction coherence
body: Discovery complete against live legacy Agent Bus + current main. Six candidates scored: frozen visual interaction coherence 22; service-stable presentation owner 17; secure/capture fallback policy 15; configuration epoch fencing 15; terminal native handoff 15; angle authority 10. Selected gap: Duo visual ownership currently does not imply interaction ownership. Current FoldSurface overlays and DisplayMirrorHost are FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE; Gen3 closing uses SnapshotSurface, so a frozen visible frame can coexist with input mutating native UI underneath. This is distinct from active presentation/native/content-freshness work. Independent boundary: exact-token input gate only for frozen/occluding Duo visuals; opening live blur remains pass-through; stale callbacks can never re-block after exact owner loss. Cheapest decisive action: Android-free exact-identity gate model + adversarial tests, then source mapping; no production commit.
